run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run. External WebFetch remained blocked by the environment egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), reconfirmed this run against www.tenders.nsw.gov.au, so no tender detail page or specification document could be opened and every opportunity is captured at headline level from search snippets only. Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and all eight state/territory portals were probed via search: concrete open/recent opportunities were re-confirmed for AusTender (Testing Laboratory Services deed ATM_2026_6786; Health Technology Assessment Support Services Panel Health/PH25/16174 closing 9 Oct 2026; ADF Family Health Program industry notice closing 30 Sep 2026) and NSW via buy.nsw (Transport for NSW movable median components closing 22 Oct 2026; Premier's Department Facilities Management services closing 8 Oct 2026). QLD (QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au), WA (Tenders WA), SA (Tenders SA), TAS (Tenders Tasmania), NT (QTOL) and ACT returned only portal landing pages / generic results with no specific new current opportunity surfaced this run. Tier 2 covered universities (a new headline opportunity captured: Monash University Moodle Managed Services partner via its TenderLink eTendering portal), local government (VendorPanel; WALGA Preferred Supplier Program RFT cycle noted as underway), GBE water corporations (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water, SA Water, WaterNSW) and public health (NSW LHDs) — no NEW specific opportunity beyond items already captured on prior runs surfaced via search. Tier 3 was attempted per mandate (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto Buy Local, Fortescue, Chevron Australia, ICN Gateway, Ramsay/St Vincent's private health): corporate opportunity detail is registration- or invitation-gated and none was publicly visible, so corporate portals are recorded in discovered_sources only, never fabricated as tenders. A Rio Tinto ~4GW onshore renewables tender in Australia surfaced as a news/aggregator discovery signal only (buyer detail gated) and is noted in gaps rather than captured as a confirmed tender. Genuinely new sources are scarce because the routine's known-source set is now broad (334 sources over ~20 runs); one genuinely new buyer-originated portal was found this run: the Chevron Supplier Management Portal (ApexPortal), distinct from the already-known australia.chevron.com supplier page.
gaps: NETWORK EGRESS BLOCK (primary cause of a degraded run, consistent with recent prior runs): WebFetch to external hosts is denied by the environment egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), reconfirmed this run against www.tenders.nsw.gov.au. The agent proxy status endpoint reported healthy (bundleCoversEveryHost:true, no relay failures) yet external host fetches are still policy-blocked, so this is an organisation egress policy, not a transient TLS/proxy fault; it was not retried or routed around per proxy guidance. Only WebSearch (US-based, via Anthropic) and the GitHub MCP were reachable.

Because no external detail page or specification document could be opened, deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria/value/contacts could not be extracted for ANY entry; all 6 tenders are headline-level and pending a detail pass. Fields not present in search snippets are left null/"" rather than inferred.

Tier 1: AusTender and all state/territory portals could only be read through WebSearch snippets, not their live ATM/RFT lists, feeds or pagination, so full lists could not be swept. QTenders (QLD), Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL and ACT Tenders returned only portal landing pages / generic aggregator results in search (no specific current opportunity surfaced this run).

AusTender ATM_2026_6786 (Testing Laboratory Services deed, anticipated commencement 1 Nov 2026, conclusion 30 Jun 2030) and ATM_2026_6551 were confirmed to exist on AusTender but their full titles, buyers, values, closing dates and documents could not be read from search snippets; ATM_2026_6786 is captured at headline level with the deed dates from the snippet and everything else null. OET-DRC-2026 (Operational Energy Transitions Defence Research Centre RFP) closed 28 Aug 2026 and was excluded as not current; JHC/RFP/2025/1 (Defence health) is a down-select to shortlisted tenderers (invitation-only) and was excluded per scope.

Tier 2 water corporations (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water, SA Water, WaterNSW) and public health LHDs surfaced only portal/aggregator pages this run; no NEW specific opportunity beyond items captured on prior runs was visible, so none was re-added to avoid duplicate/unverified entries.

Tier 3 SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery: no specific currently-open, publicly-visible Australian RFx could be confirmed via search (results were generic platform/API/how-to pages). Corporate opportunities on Ariba/Coupa/BHP/Rio Tinto Buy Local/Fortescue/Chevron/ICN Gateway are registration- or invitation-gated; recorded as portals in discovered_sources, not as tenders. Invitation-only management-consultancy RFPs remain out of scope and were not fabricated.

DISCOVERY SIGNAL (not captured as a tender): a Rio Tinto tender for ~4GW of onshore renewables in Australia was reported via news/aggregator (pv-tech.org); the buyer's own opportunity detail is gated (Rio Tinto Buy Local / ICN Project Portal). Recorded here as a signal to verify on an authenticated/unblocked run rather than captured, to avoid presenting aggregator/news data as a confirmed opportunity.

Source discovery is saturating: of every candidate source examined this run (Monash eTendering, WALGA Preferred Supplier Program, Audit Office of NSW open tenders, WaterNSW procurement, Rio Tinto Buy Local, ICN Gateway, Ramsay Health, St Vincent's Health, Chevron Australia supplier opportunities) all but one were already in the known-source set of 334. Only the Chevron Supplier Management Portal (chevron.apexportal.net, ApexPortal platform) was genuinely new this run.
recommended_seed_additions: https://chevron.apexportal.net/ - Chevron Supplier Management Portal (ApexPortal e-sourcing platform); buyer-originated supplier/e-sourcing portal distinct from the already-known australia.chevron.com supplier page. Registration-gated; check monthly.

https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm?orderby=Close+Date - AusTender open-ATM list ordered by close date; when egress is unblocked, sweep this and follow pagination for full Tier 1 Commonwealth coverage instead of relying on WebSearch snippets.

INFRASTRUCTURE NOTE (not a source): resolve the WebFetch/egress block. Every run since coverage began has been degraded to headline-level because external hosts are policy-blocked; an authenticated, unblocked run is required to extract deliverables, requirements, values, closing times, documents and contacts from the tenders' own detail pages.
